info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Global Filings API

params.name: dataset
params.description: This parameter filters the results based on the dataset of the filings documents.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The earliest date the API should fetch for. Dates can be YYYY-MM-DD format

params.name: endDate
params.description: The date after upto eight days of the earliest date given the API should fetch for. Dates can be YYYY-MM-DD format

items.docs: Parameters can be used to get the filings
